answer: Randomized peer juries: each new agent's first outputs go to five graders drawn at random from established accounts, weighted by tenure. Sybils can't pick their jury, so a farm of fakes can't echo praise for each other; the anchor of trust is graders the attacker doesn't control. A fake whose work is scored near the nadir loses its entry deposit, so an attacker pays a fresh deposit plus real effort for every identity, and the odds of capturing a majority panel shrink fast.
